title: Add colored indicators for relationship status
description:
Use terminal colors to indicate relationship health in list and show output:

Colors for dependencies:
- Green ✓ - Issue has no blockers, ready to work on
- Yellow ⚠ - Issue is blocked by incomplete dependencies
- Red ⛔ - Issue has circular dependency or invalid relationship
- Blue → - Issue is blocking other issues (informational)

Colors for epic membership:
- Cyan [epic] with child count colored by completion percentage
- Gray for issues not in any epic (when epics exist)

Benefits:
- Instant visual feedback on project health
- Quickly identify problems (red indicators)
- See what's ready to work on (green)
- Navigate by visual cues

Should respect terminal color support and --no-color flag.
